name: B10-0307/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Russia’s unacceptable provocative actions and drone incursions into Romania, the Baltic states and Finland
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Russia’s unacceptable provocative actions and drone incursions into Romania, the Baltic states and Finland
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is setting out its opinion and asking for action. It condemns Russia for sending drones into the airspace of Romania, Finland, Latvia, Lithuania and Estonia, and says these are deliberate acts of hybrid warfare. It asks the EU to improve drone detection and defence, to spend more on defence through a new shared fund, to tighten sanctions on Russia, and to apply stricter visa rules for Russian travellers.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a request for stronger drone defence, new sanctions and stricter visas.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, defence firms, Russian travellers, and people near airports and power plants.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament sends its demands to EU governments and the Commission, which decide whether to act.
